attest.summary: The per-item ledger does NOT reconcile with the theme-level "44验/40开" — it reveals a large silent-drop gap. Per-item totals: 94 items → 49 closed + 4 folded (into HIGHs: memory-b F8/F9, mlx MED-5, x-test-integrity F5) + 4 explicitly-open-with-blocker (orch MED-3, policy MED-2, tools R2/R3 corpus, x-concurrency MED-9) + 37 unaccounted. The granularities differ (94 per-item hits vs ~55 theme MEDs vs the 84-summing 44/40 figure), so a raw digit match was never possible; but the substantive finding is that the theme-level "40开" does NOT cover the 37 unaccounted items. Those 37 are qualitatively worse than "open": each is traceable to NO remediation commit, NO §8–§11 ledger row, and is absent from the §11 line-501 residual list — they were swallowed behind aggregate theme closures that claimed "all MED closed" (e.g. §8 line 485 for the M-i device batch, the M-f "全部 MED 全闭" rollup which has no closure row at all, the M-k spine fold that closed F1/F2/F4/F5 and skipped F3, and the x-test-integrity report truncated at F3 so F4/F6/F7 never entered the ledger). Whole clusters are dropped wholesale: all 6 mlx-adapter-core MED-6..11 (M-f theme never got a closure row), all 5 organ-eval findings (only characterized in the §4 health score, never themed), and 4 runtimecore-b findings. So the honest verdict: 44验 overstates verification (several "closes" are doc-only comment-lie fixes leaving the behavioral clause live — memory-b F3, or partial — hostkit-rest MED-2), and 40开 understates the true not-closed population (4 tracked-open + 37 untracked = 41), while mislabeling 37 genuinely-dropped items as if the theme aggregates had absorbed them. The 55/55 attestation cannot be honestly signed: 37 MED findings are unaccounted.
